sources.title: Didi backend interview note exact balanced-binary-tree prompt
Bottom-up height sentinel versus independent recomputed-height oracle

claims.text: The recoverable source asks only to determine whether a tree is a balanced binary tree; it does not preserve a formal balance definition, language/API, empty-tree behavior, or a BST/AVL validity requirement.

The candidate explicitly adopts the standard height-balanced definition (absolute child-height difference at every node at most one), treats the empty tree as balanced, and does not add BST ordering as a source constraint.

The bottom-up sentinel implementation matches an independent oracle that recomputes heights at every node on fixed edge cases and 5000 deterministic randomized trees, including internal imbalance masked by equal root-side heights.

validation.reported_stdout: PASS fixed=8 randomized=5000 oracle=independent-recomputed-height balanced=1003 unbalanced=3997 empty=true internal-imbalance=true linear-sentinel=true
